# nb-studio delegation

## delegation get

Get a delegation

```bash
nb-studio delegation get <delegation>
```

| Argument     | Description |
| ------------ | ----------- |
| `delegation` |             |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `GET /api/delegations/{delegationId}` (`delegationsGet`)

## delegation list

List the issues a conversation delegated

The issues the caller’s conversation handed to agents through executed plans, oldest first, followed or not. A bounded list: one conversation’s.

```bash
nb-studio delegation list --conversation <string>
```

| Flag             | Type   | Description                                               |
| ---------------- | ------ | --------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--conversation` | string | The conversation whose delegated work to list. (required) |

**Output:** A list; with `--json`, `result.data` is the array and `result.meta` the paging.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `GET /api/delegations` (`delegationsList`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio delegation list --conversation c1
```

## delegation update

Stop or resume following a delegation

With `followed: false` the conversation hears no more of the issue: no cards, no wakes.

```bash
nb-studio delegation update <delegation> --followed
```

| Argument     | Description |
| ------------ | ----------- |
| `delegation` |             |

| Flag         | Type    | Description                                                                                                    |
| ------------ | ------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--followed` | boolean | False stops following the issue: no more cards or wakes in the conversation; true follows it again. (required) |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `PATCH /api/delegations/{delegationId}` (`delegationsUpdate`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio delegation update 7 --followed false
```
